import hashlib,json,sys,types
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read(262145)
assert len(raw)==120469 and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=="4f59c46988278e694f90f6bf634c1300b26c329266ecc1b192fc1771067a7546"
p=json.loads(raw);assert p['schema']==1 and set(p)=={'schema','control_source','control_pin','payload'}
src=p['control_source'].encode();assert p['control_pin']=={'bytes':len(src),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(src).hexdigest()}
assert hashlib.sha256(src).hexdigest()=="708b979512ef3a9570ac3b1e7588db59d7cd3347b3843f059b2514e424fa32ba"
m=types.ModuleType('three_fixed_target_metadata_controls');m.__file__='<pure-controls>'
exec(compile(src,m.__file__,'exec'),m.__dict__)
out=m.run_controls(p['payload']);assert out['ok'] is True and out['count']==49 and len(out['cases'])==49
assert all(x['passed'] is True for x in out['cases'])
out.update(control_source_sha256=p['control_pin']['sha256'],packet_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
encoded=json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'));assert len(encoded.encode())<=32768;print(encoded,flush=True)
